purpose: Repository guard that prevents SHRESTA-BE from packaging or serving static image assets at runtime.
businessRules: Image binaries must not be placed under src/ or runtime Spring resources.
seed/shresta-media is the only allowed repository media-binary location and exists only to seed S3-compatible object storage.
Runtime Java/config must not reference backend-local media routes such as /shresta-media or /shresta-assets.
Gradle check depends on this guard through verifyNoRuntimeStaticMedia.
